title: Atlas dictionary -> meso-discipline assignments (reviewed seed)
description: Maps each atlas dictionary to a meso_code of the estate's ratified Russian-Indology meso vocabulary (IndologyScholars curation/meso_discipline_crosswalk.csv vocabulary). The discipline taxonomy itself is NEVER re-derived here (H3567 ruling F5, released by F5c): the build joins these assignments through the crosswalk to curation/disciplines.csv. Confidence is the assignment's own; it multiplies with the crosswalk's confidence downstream. null meso_code = no confident facet in the meso vocabulary; these stay unassigned instead of being forced.
assignmentNote: General Sanskrit lexicography has no dedicated meso code; the nearest Sanskrit facet is sanskrit_grammar_panini (crosswalk target sanskritology, whose ratified scope reads 'Vedic studies, Sanskrit grammar, Sanskrit texts and epic'). Those assignments carry confidence <= 0.6 deliberately.
feedIdFold: correction-feed lowercase dict ids fold onto coverage codes caselessly, except pw->PWG (Petersburger Woerterbuch, Boehtlingk-Roth) and pwg->PWK (Boehtlingk 1879-1889 kuertzere Fassung).
